recorded: Original run from a copy with Angular 21.2.8, @angular/ssr 21.2.7, Genkit 1.32.0 with @genkit-ai/google-genai 1.32.0, Express 5.2.1, and Node.js 26.12.1, installed with npm ci, and driven in headless Google Chrome. It ran with NG_CLI_ANALYTICS=false npx ng serve --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1 instead of npm start, which fixes port 4200: the Angular CLI's dev server renders every page on the server and mounts server.ts's Express app, API included. The original's googleAI() plugin always calls https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com, so the copy passes it baseUrl from GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, the variable Google's GenAI SDKs read, its only patch, and the cases point that variable to the replay with a placeholder key in GEMINI_API_KEY. Ollama serves no generateContent endpoint, so record.mjs recorded the copy in front of a translator that sent each request to Ollama 0.40.11's chat API with gpt-oss:20b and the response schema as the format, and wrapped each answer in Gemini's documented response. The stand-in filled in fields beyond the schema, which allows them, and the cases expect them, since the server answers the model's object as it came. Gemini's errors and the broken answers are synthesized. Ids are random UUIDs, so the cases check their shape and compare a card's address with the details page's. Angular clears a draft typed before hydration ends, so the page cases type it again until the button takes it, and the replay holds some answers for 1.5 seconds so the cases can read the loading state. Every case passed in each of 3 runs.
